scenario: Scenario 1: register failure leaves a terminal DOWN with no repair
notes: Reached and confirmed. Primary finding MC-1 (Scenario 1, fault: ZooKeeper connection loss only, no session expiry): during the workload's collection CREATE, a follower core publishes ACTIVE, then two disconnects of its node's ZK client, each shorter than the 20 s session timeout, exhaust all 8 ZkCmdExecutor ConnectionLoss retries of forceUpdateCollection. The exception escapes ZkController.register, ZkContainer.registerInZk's catch-all publishes DOWN and swallows it, CREATE reports success, and nothing re-registers or recovers the core, so all 31 polls see a DOWN replica on a live node and fail() throws at AbstractDistribZkTestBase.java:185 (2 of 2 runs; reproduction used real disconnects through the framework's SocketProxy plus a timing-only 1 s pause, per confirmed-bugs.md). Two more TargetSafe counterexamples were also reproduced at the same frame: MC-2 (Scenario 2, one session expiry racing the reconnect's re-registration, spec/output/hunt_s2_expiry_reregister_race_bfs.out, repro/test_bugMC-2_expiry_reregister_race.sh; mechanism kinds FAULT+INTERLEAVING) and MC-3 (Scenario 3, two session expiries leaving an uncancelled recovery blocked in PrepRecovery, spec/output/hunt_s3_post_expiry_nonconvergence_bfs.out, repro/test_bugMC-3_post_expiry_stale_recovery.sh; FAULT+INTERLEAVING). Code-review findings CR-2 (transposed shardId in checkRecovery, KNOWN-fixed upstream) and CR-3 (removeCollectionStateWatcher leaves a frozen cached view, KNOWN-fixed as SOLR-9440) also fire the target at line 185 but have no model counterexample. Scenario 4 (Overseer stale replay) found no violation in an exhaustive 1-shard run, and CR-1 for that mechanism is a FALSE POSITIVE. Primary hunts used 2 nodes, 1 shard x 2 replicas; the supplementary 2-shard runs on the workload layout timed out at 30 min without a violation and are inconclusive.
